seed_command: none (pnpm — NOT npm; the nightly journey is read-only and leaves all paid AI keys unset)
reset_command: remove throwaway WORKSPACE_ROOT and FACTORY_DATA_DIR contents and restart
cleanup: rm -rf .eva-tmp/factory-deck && remove throwaway WORKSPACE_ROOT and FACTORY_DATA_DIR directories
prohibited_actions: do not start a Factory run — the read-only shell journey must never POST /api/runs
NO real AI spend — leave Anthropic/OpenAI keys unset and keep paid/free provider routes disabled for this shell-only check
no deployment or publication of anything the factory produces
never let workspace writes escape the disposable WORKSPACE_ROOT

coverage.feature: New Run hero identifies the app

coverage.unautomated_reason: only populated by real assembly-line runs, which are blocked (no Anthropic credits) or prohibited (no real AI spend)
workspaces are produced by runs; with runs blocked, there is nothing deterministic to assert
log content depends on a completed run; blocked for the same external-service reason
provider and execution settings are owner configuration; changing them is out of scope for a read-only nightly journey
blocked_by_external_service — Anthropic credits empty; any run requiring a model call is out of scope until unblocked

journeys.name: UI loads and shows the Factory / New Run hero
journeys.user_impact: If the deck UI does not load, the owner cannot start, inspect, or demo any factory run.
